title: SignUpForm
wrapsNative: androidx.compose.foundation.layout.Column with MonarchTextField (autofill content types PersonFullName, NewUsername and EmailAddress), MonarchPasswordInput (new-password purpose), MonarchPasswordStrengthMeter, MonarchTermsAcceptance, MonarchInlineNotice, MonarchButton and MonarchLink
summary: A recipe, not a component: create an account with a name, an email and a new password, with the password rules, terms to accept, field errors and a link to sign in.
whenToUse: For the sign-up screen of an app that has its own accounts.
whenNotToUse: When the app signs people up only with Rook ID, show MonarchSignInWithRookButton. To sign in, use the SignInForm recipe; to join from an invitation with a known email, show the email as text instead of a field.
api: MonarchTextField(value = name, onValueChange = …, modifier = Modifier.semantics { contentType = ContentType.PersonFullName }, label = "Full name", errorText = nameError)

MonarchTextField(value = email, onValueChange = …, modifier = Modifier.semantics { contentType = ContentType.NewUsername + ContentType.EmailAddress }, label = "Email", errorText = emailError, keyboardOptions = KeyboardOptions(keyboardType = KeyboardType.Email, autoCorrectEnabled = false))
MonarchPasswordInput(value = password, onValueChange = …, label = "Password", errorText = passwordError, purpose = MonarchPasswordInputPurpose.New)
MonarchTermsAcceptance(accepted = accepted, onAcceptedChange = …, documents = documents, showRequiredError = tried)
MonarchButton(text = "Create account", onClick = createAccount, modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(), variant = MonarchButtonVariant.Primary, loading = creating)

options.name: nameError
options.description: An empty name, shown on the field after the first attempt.

options.name: emailError
options.description: An empty or malformed email, or the server's "already in use" answer, shown on the field.

options.name: passwordError
options.description: A password that misses a rule of MonarchPasswordRule.defaults(), shown on the field; the meter lists which rule.

options.name: formError
options.description: Any other failure, in a danger MonarchInlineNotice above the fields.

options.name: creating
options.description: Passed to Create account's loading while the request runs.

states.name: ready
states.description: The title, the name, email and password fields, the strength meter with its rules, the terms checkbox, Create account and the link to sign in.

states.name: field errors
states.description: An empty name, an empty or malformed email, a password that misses a rule and unaccepted terms each show their error before anything is sent.

states.name: creating
states.description: Create account shows its progress indicator and reads "Loading".

states.name: email taken
states.description: The server's answer goes on the email field; any other failure goes in a danger MonarchInlineNotice above the fields.

states.name: invitation
states.description: Prefill the email from an invitation and show it as text instead of a field.

appearance: Every part is an existing Monarch component: outlined fields with their errors, the strength meter's segments and rule list, the terms checkbox row, a full-width primary button and a standalone link. Light, dark and both high-contrast themes follow from those components.
platformNotes: The web's SignUpForm is one component with onSubmit, its own messages and an optional confirm-password field. On Android, as on iOS, it is a recipe, because the request and navigation belong to the app. There is no confirm field: the password's reveal button shows typos, and the new-password purpose of MonarchPasswordInput lets autofill services and Google Password Manager suggest a strong password and save it. The email field's NewUsername and EmailAddress content types, and PersonFullName on the name, tell autofill what to offer. Optional single sign-on goes above the fields with MonarchSignInWithRookButton and an "or" divider, as in the SignInForm recipe.
accessibility: The title has the heading semantics.
Field errors come from MonarchTextField and MonarchPasswordInput, which show them in words and mark the fields as in error.
The strength meter reads the strength and each rule as met or not met, in words.
The terms checkbox is one element with the checkbox role; its required error is a visible message.
Create account is a MonarchButton with a 48dp target and a loading state; the sign-in link is a MonarchLink.
edgeCases: Trim spaces around the email and the name but never change the password.
Never save the password in the instance state; keep it in remember, not rememberSaveable.
Show errors only after the first attempt, then update them as the person types.
Send the accepted document versions and the date from MonarchTermsAcceptanceDetails with the request.

examples.title: With terms (try an @example.org address)
examples.template:
Column(verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(MonarchTheme.spacing.space4)) {
    formError?.let { MonarchInlineNotice(message = it, tone = MonarchTone.Danger) }
    MonarchTextField(
        value = name,
        onValueChange = { name = it },
        modifier = Modifier.semantics { contentType = ContentType.PersonFullName },
        label = "Full name",
        required = true,
        errorText = nameError,
        keyboardOptions = KeyboardOptions(capitalization = KeyboardCapitalization.Words),
    )
    MonarchTextField(
        value = email,
        onValueChange = { email = it },
        modifier = Modifier.semantics { contentType = ContentType.NewUsername + ContentType.EmailAddress },
        label = "Email",
        required = true,
        errorText = emailError,
        keyboardOptions = KeyboardOptions(keyboardType = KeyboardType.Email, autoCorrectEnabled = false),
    )
    MonarchPasswordInput(
        value = password,
        onValueChange = { password = it },
        label = "Password",
        required = true,
        errorText = passwordError,
        purpose = MonarchPasswordInputPurpose.New,
    )
    MonarchPasswordStrengthMeter(password = password, rules = rules)
    MonarchTermsAcceptance(
        accepted = accepted,
        onAcceptedChange = { value, details ->
            accepted = value
            // Send details.versions and details.dateMillis with the request.
        },
        documents = documents,
        showRequiredError = tried,
    )
    MonarchButton(
        text = "Create account",
        onClick = createAccount,
        modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
        variant = MonarchButtonVariant.Primary,
        loading = creating,
    )
    Row(
        modifier = Modifier.align(Alignment.CenterHorizontally),
        horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(MonarchTheme.spacing.space1),
        verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
    ) {
        MonarchText(text = "Already have an account?")
        MonarchLink(
            text = "Sign in",
            onClick = { /* Open sign-in. */ },
            variant = MonarchLinkVariant.Standalone,
        )
    }
}
